class.name: LocalizationCatalog
class.brief_description: Base class of catalogs that store localized strings per key and locale.

method.name: add_key
method.description: Adds a row for [param key] and [param context] and returns its row number. If the row exists, returns its row number without a change.

method.name: add_locale
method.description: Adds an empty column for [param locale] (after the existing ones). Nothing happens if the locale exists. Setting a text of a new locale adds its column too.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all keys and locales.

method.name: find_key
method.description: Returns the row number of [param key] with [param context], or [code]-1[/code] if the catalog has no such row.

method.name: get_entry
method.description: Returns the row of [param key] with [param context] as a [Dictionary] in the shape of one entry of the JSON format: [code]_key[/code] and [code]_context[/code] (only for a key with a context), [code]_plural[/code] or [code]_type[/code], one [code]_<name>[/code] field per translator note, and per locale the text, or an [Array] of plural forms. Empty texts and notes are left out. Returns an empty [Dictionary] if the key is missing. Loads all locales. [codeblocks] [gdscript] print(catalog.get_entry("APPLE")) # { "_plural": "APPLES", "en": ["%d apple", "%d apples"], "_notes": "Inventory" } [/gdscript] [csharp] GD.Print(catalog.GetEntry("APPLE")); // { "_plural": "APPLES", "en": ["%d apple", "%d apples"], "_notes": "Inventory" } [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_file_extensions
method.description: Returns the file extensions of catalogs: [code]lcat[/code] and the text formats ([code]csv[/code], [code]json[/code], [code]yaml[/code], [code]yml[/code], [code]toml[/code], [code]ini[/code], [code]xml[/code]). Text formats are loaded by [ResourceLoader] only with a catalog type hint, for example [code]ResourceLoader.load("res://texts.json", "TextLocalizationCatalog")[/code], because they do not name their kind and other loaders own these extensions otherwise. A [code].csv[/code] file that Godot imports as [Translation] is not a catalog: set its import to "Keep File".

method.name: get_key
method.description: Returns the key of the row [param row] (between [code]0[/code] and [member key_count] - 1).

method.name: get_key_context
method.description: Returns the context of the row [param row], or an empty [StringName] if the row has no context.

method.name: get_missing_rows
method.description: Returns the row numbers that have no text in [param locale] (all rows if the catalog has no such locale). Loads the locale.

method.name: get_note
method.description: Returns the translator note of [param key] in the note [param column] (the name without the leading [code]_[/code]: [code]"notes"[/code] for a [code]_notes[/code] column), or an empty string. Notes are never used to look up texts.

method.name: get_translated_count
method.description: Returns the number of rows that have a text in [param locale]. Known without loading the locale (it is stored in the locale table of a [code].lcat[/code] file).

method.name: has_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the catalog has a row for [param key] with [param context].

method.name: has_locale
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the catalog has a column for [param locale], loaded or not.

method.name: is_locale_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the texts of [param locale] are in memory. Only a catalog loaded from a [code].lcat[/code] file has locales that are not loaded.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Replaces the content of this catalog with the file at [param path]. The extension selects the format: [code]lcat[/code] (binary, locales are loaded on first use), [code]csv[/code], [code]json[/code], [code]yaml[/code]/[code]yml[/code], [code]toml[/code], [code]ini[/code] or [code]xml[/code]. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if the format's module is disabled, [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if a [code].lcat[/code] file holds another kind of catalog.

method.name: load_from_text
method.description: Replaces the content of this catalog with [param text] in the text format [param format]. See the class description for the layout of each format. [param options] sets the CSV delimiter ([member SerializerOptions.csv_delimiter]); without options, CSV text uses the delimiter found in its header row. Its header setting is ignored: a catalog CSV always has a header row.

method.name: load_locale
method.description: Reads the texts of [param locale] from the [code].lcat[/code] file the catalog was loaded from, if they are not in memory yet, and emits [signal locale_loaded]. Getters such as [method TextLocalizationCatalog.get_text] do this automatically.

method.name: remove_key
method.description: Removes the row of [param key] with [param context] from all locales. The rows after it move up by one.

method.name: remove_locale
method.description: Removes the column of [param locale].

method.name: rename_key
method.description: Renames the row of [param key] with [param context] to [param new_key] with [param new_context]. The row keeps its position, texts, plural forms, plural key and notes. Fails if [param key] is missing or [param new_key] with [param new_context] exists already.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes the catalog to [param path] in the format of its extension (see [method load_from_file]). Loads all locales first.

method.name: set_entry
method.description: Replaces the plural key or expected type, the translator notes and the texts of [param key] with [param context] by those of [param entry] (the shape of [method get_entry]). The key is added if missing, locales and note columns of [param entry] are added too; fields the entry does not have are cleared. [code]_key[/code] and [code]_context[/code] of [param entry] are ignored. The editor uses it for undo and redo: the entry from [method get_entry] before a change restores the key. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var before = catalog.get_entry("HELLO") catalog.set_entry("HELLO", { "en": "Hi", "de": "Hallo", "_notes": "Greeting" }) catalog.set_entry("HELLO", before) # Back to the old texts. [/gdscript] [csharp] var before = catalog.GetEntry("HELLO"); catalog.SetEntry("HELLO", new Godot.Collections.Dictionary { { "en", "Hi" }, { "de", "Hallo" }, { "_notes", "Greeting" } }); catalog.SetEntry("HELLO", before); // Back to the old texts. [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: set_note
method.description: Sets the translator note of [param key] in the note [param column], adding the key and the column if needed. An empty [param note] removes it. [code]"key"[/code], [code]"context"[/code] and the column of the kind ([code]"plural"[/code] or [code]"type"[/code]) are reserved. [codeblocks] [gdscript] catalog.set_note("MENU_START", "Button on the title screen") catalog.set_note("MENU_START", "12", &"", &"max_length") catalog.save_to_file("res://translations/menu.csv") # keys,en,_notes,_max_length [/gdscript] [csharp] catalog.SetNote("MENU_START", "Button on the title screen"); catalog.SetNote("MENU_START", "12", "", "max_length"); catalog.SaveToFile("res://translations/menu.csv"); // keys,en,_notes,_max_length [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: to_text
method.description: Returns the catalog as text in [param format], or an empty [String] on error (for example a disabled module). Loads all locales. [param options] sets for example the CSV delimiter or the indentation of JSON and XML (JSON without options is indented with tabs).

method.name: unload_locale
method.description: Frees the texts of [param locale]; they are read again from the [code].lcat[/code] file when needed. Fails if the locale was changed since loading, or the catalog was not loaded from a [code].lcat[/code] file.

method.name: validate

members.member: The locale channel the keys of this catalog follow (see [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]): [code]&"interface"[/code], [code]&"audio"[/code], [code]&"subtitles"[/code] or a custom one. [TextLocalizationCatalog]s use [code]&"interface"[/code] by default; for [ResourceLocalizationCatalog]s an empty channel means the channel of each key's type. Stored in [code].tres[/code], [code].lcat[/code], JSON, YAML, TOML and INI (not in CSV and XML).
The number of rows (keys with their context).
The locales of the catalog, in column order, loaded or not.
The names of the translator note columns, without the leading [code]_[/code], in the order they were read or added, for example [code]["notes", "max_length"][/code].

signal.name: locale_loaded
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread after the texts of [param locale] were read from the [code].lcat[/code] file.
